notes:
Summary: Large fintech sec team evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) to host inference for customer-facing chat and backend reranking. Primary ask: customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM backing, per-region key residency, and auditable key usage logs. Tech lead: VP of Security (R. Gonzalez).

- Quote from security call: "We cannot accept any provider-managed keys for production PII workloads; HSM backed CMKs required."
- Prefer AWS KMS with external key material (ImportKey) or AWS CloudHSM-backed keys. Also evaluating Azure Key Vault + HSM and GCP KMS with CMEK for multi-cloud DR.
- Legal: need key-escrow prohibition clause; no vendor access to private key material. They want attestation for key rotation policies and KMS access audit logs.
- POC ask: demo PKCS#11 HSM integration, KMS envelope encryption flow, and sample audit log export in CloudTrail / Azure Monitor format.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to pay premium for Private + HSM but want clear incremental ARR for Dedicated versus Private BYOK.
- Compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 already required; planning internal pentest and will request Redwood pen-test reports and architecture diagrams.
- Residency: data-at-rest residency per customer region (US-EAST and EU-WEST primary) and retention controls for message logs.
- Routing/fallback: must support graceful fallback to a lower-cost, non-BYOK model only if explicitly allowed by contract; prefer policy-level routing to avoid accidental failover.

Stated POC success criteria:
1) End-to-end key lifecycle: customer imports key material, Redwood runtime encrypts model cache & token logs using envelope keys, HSM signs usage events.
2) Audit trail: full KMS key usage in CloudTrail-like exports + tamper-evident log retention for 1 year.
3) Performance: sub-100ms median tail latency on chat path with encryption overhead <8%.

Internal notes: SE will produce integration design with diagrams: network flow (VPC peering/private link), KMS API calls pattern, HSM appliance options (Thales, AWS CloudHSM), and proposed SLA amendments.
